meta_cites_federal_law_008.answer: The term “Partnership Schools” shall mean DCPS schools operated by private, not-for-profit management companies under contracts with DCPS pursuant to 20 U.S.C. § 6316(b)(8)(B)(iii) of the No Child Left Behind Act (NCLB). | All Partnership Schools shall be schools that are required to be restructured under NCLB. | DCPS shall provide written notice of potential school reform, inclusive of all options under NCLB for restructuring, to the WTU and all Teachers in the affected schools that have been identified.
